rule: Website shows euro prices. Paystack is billed in ZAR at the day's EUR to ZAR rate: ZAR cents = round(EUR price × rate × 100). The Worker fetches the rate from frankfurter.app (ECB) with a fallback to open.er-api.com, caches it in KV for 24 hours, and uses 19.25 only if both fetches fail and there is no cache.
